fields.Name: T104 - Query Drawer Name-Required Validation
fields.Description: Exercises the drawer's required-field guard (Save [disabled]="!DrawerName.trim()" + DrawerNameError) — a validation code path specific to the query drawer, distinct from generic entity-form required-field validation.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to Data Explorer, and open the Queries section. Open the New Query drawer via the '+' (New Query) icon button. Leave the Name field blank and attempt to Save. Success is that the save is BLOCKED — the Save button stays disabled while Name is empty (and/or a 'Name is required' hint appears on the Name field). Then type any Name and confirm the Save button becomes enabled. If the create '+' button is absent due to permissions, report that instead. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: With the Name field empty, the Save button is disabled (and/or a 'Name is required' validation hint is shown)
After entering a Name, the Save button becomes enabled
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
